description: This source file is a shell script implementing a test suite for the Git post-rewrite hook. It sets up various Git repository states and verifies the behavior of the post-rewrite hook during different Git operations such as commit amend, rebase, and interactive rebase. The script uses functions and commands to automate testing and validate that the hook receives correct inputs.

methods.name: clear_hook_input
methods.description: Removes auxiliary files used to capture hook input data.

methods.name: verify_hook_input
methods.description: Compares captured hook input data files against expected values to verify correctness.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Configures a fake editor for testing interactive rebase scenarios.

methods.name: test_fail_interactive_rebase
methods.description: Runs an interactive rebase with simulated user input to test failure scenarios and subsequent rebase continuation.
